title: Unify all IDs to i64 snowflake — eliminate TEXT UUID for users/personas
description: The canonical schema has a type split: posts/media/notifications use INTEGER snowflake IDs, but users/personas use TEXT UUIDs. This causes type conversion pain everywhere. ActivityPub doesn't require UUIDs — internal IDs are never exposed to federation. Unify to i64 snowflake IDs everywhere: schema migration v4 changes users.id and personas.id from TEXT to INTEGER, all fieldwork modules change user_id/persona_id params from &str to i64, all three servers update accordingly. One ID type, zero conversions.
close_reason: Unified all IDs to i64 snowflake across fieldwork (30 files, 361 tests) and all three servers. UUID/String IDs eliminated. One type for all IDs.
